premises.text: Good ideas get lost across desktop, Dropbox, email, and other repositories
premises.evidence_span: Is it in my desktop? Is it in my Dropbox? Is it in my inbox? Where is my great idea?

premises.text: Docurated discovers files across repositories and decomposes them into reusable page, chart, text, and image components
premises.evidence_span: discover all of your files across any repository, email, desktop, third parties

premises.text: Components are indexed so one search returns the best relevant pages by content and context, improving with use
premises.evidence_span: Each component is individually indexed and normalized

premises.text: Natural language processing labels content topics without manual tagging
premises.evidence_span: You don't ever have to tag anything. We will analyze your words, we will analyze your ideas, and we will tell you what your content is about

premises.text: Users mash up pages visually into collages and export to PowerPoint or PDF regardless of source format
premises.evidence_span: Each page can be mashed up from any other page, from any other file format

premises.text: Collages can be shared via visual email preview or saved for access anywhere
premises.evidence_span: share your collage with an individual or a group, and they will receive a beautiful, visual email

premises.text: Availability to Dropbox users makes the product accessible beyond large enterprises
premises.evidence_span: If you have a Dropbox account, DocuRated is yours

value.text: People find and reuse their best ideas from scattered files in one place
value.evidence_span: one place where all of our ideas are at our fingertips

causal_links.evidence_span: your best content, your best page, not a file, your best page appears to you in the order of relevance
each waiting to be used in a different and new way
we believe that DocuRated belongs to everyone

notes: Learn-over-time ranking folded into P3 as quantitative/behavioral detail of relevance search. Customer testimonial treated as evidence, not a new premise. $9B enterprise spend left as market framing. Singleton D3 retained as separately revisable distribution/access condition.
